detailed_description: Base32 Encoder/Decoder converts text to Base32 or decodes Base32 back to text in the browser. Choose Encode or Decode, paste text into the input area, click Convert, and review the output textarea. Encoding uses TextEncoder bytes, Base32 alphabet characters, and `=` padding. Decoding removes `=` padding, accepts lowercase or uppercase Base32 letters, and shows a generic error message when the input contains characters outside the Base32 alphabet. The output can be copied with the Copy button.
usage_steps: Choose Encode or Decode with the mode buttons.
Paste or type the text or Base32 string into the input textarea.
Click Convert to generate the output.
If decoding fails, check whether the input contains non-Base32 characters.
Copy the output when you need to reuse the converted text.
usage_examples: Encode a short text token into Base32 for a documentation example.
Decode a Base32 sample string to check the original text.
Compare how a Unicode phrase is represented after browser-side encoding.
Copy a converted value for use in a test fixture or note.
